tasks.name: docker-up-dev
tasks.cmd:
set -euo pipefail
docker compose up postgresql rabbitmq redis -d
if [ "${JACKIN:-}" = "1" ] || [ "${JACKIN_CLAUDE_ENV:-}" = "jackin" ]; then
  echo "Docker environment detected; waiting for PostgreSQL to be ready..."
  until docker exec chainargos-postgresql pg_isready -U chainargos -d chainargos >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done
  echo "Initializing databases..."
  docker exec -i chainargos-postgresql psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=0 -U chainargos < docker/postgresql/init-databases.sql
fi
